SELECT store_key, store_id, store_name, city FROM dim_store 
WHERE store_name LIKE '%Jyväskylä%' OR store_name LIKE '%Palokka%' OR store_name LIKE '%Jyväskylä%Palokka%'
ORDER BY is_current DESC, store_name

calls.statement:
SELECT fsw.store_key, fsw.product_key, fsw.week_ending_date, fsw.closing_units, ds.store_name, dp.sku, dp.product_name
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
JOIN dim_store ds ON fsw.store_key = ds.store_key
JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE fsw.store_key = 30 
  AND fsw.product_key = 11
ORDER BY fsw.week_ending_date DESC
LIMIT 5

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  dp.sku,
  dp.product_name,
  ds.store_id,
  ds.store_name,
  fsw.week_ending_date,
  fsw.closing_units
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
JOIN dim_store ds ON fsw.store_key = ds.store_key
JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE fsw.store_key = 30 
  AND fsw.product_key = 11
  AND fsw.week_ending_date = '2026-10-04'
